title: EvalSetV1
description: K-10 v1, the eval-set format (02-contracts K-10; arch 08 lines 419 to 449; arch 10 line 552; arch 12 line 590: 'the eval set, generated from the master's needs and gives keys'; BP 8 'Bundle', 'Eval gate', 'Journey milestone'; BP starting shape, last paragraph; BP section 10's release card). Two documents: a gold-set item (goldItem), one turn or a whole chat walked from the step graph with its gold label, and an accuracy report (accuracyReport), what one eval run of a bundle on the gold set or its smoke slice found, per section 08 measure and per journey. The root is either, so the type generator writes a type for each (ADR-005). K-01's, K-02's and K-08's definitions are reused by relative $ref where the meaning is the same. Not model-facing, so number and length limits are schema rules here. The report's arithmetic (each point estimate, its 95% interval, each status, the cost per booking, the changed-effect counts) is the named rule reportNumbers in eval-set.rules.mjs.

itemId.title: GoldItemId
itemId.description: A gold-set item's id: lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, so it can name a file and a results folder (QUESTIONS.md M2-qa-frontend.8: per-item results kept under evals/results/<gold-set version>/<bundle id>/). Written once and never reused (02-contracts K-10 'its id').

goldSetVersion.title: GoldSetVersion
goldSetVersion.description: A gold-set version: letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, never a slash, so it can name a results folder (02-contracts K-10 'set version', 'gold-set version'; QUESTIONS.md M2-qa-frontend.8).

journey.title: EvalJourney
journey.description: A journey, 1 to 12, as K-01 v1 numbers it (journeyGate.journey; 02-contracts sections 9 and 10).

bundleId.title: EvalBundleId
bundleId.description: A bundle id as K-01 v1's manifest spells it, as K-08 v1 restates it: the content hash, 64 lowercase hex characters, and the build number from 1 (K-01 v1 manifest.bundleId; K-08 v1 bundleId; CQ-09; tour line 658: every published bundle stays readable for replay).

hash.description: The content hash (K-01 v1 manifest.bundleId.hash; K-01 v1 sha256).

build.description: The build number, counting publishes from 1 (K-01 v1 manifest.bundleId.build; C-072).

fieldValue.title: EvalValue
fieldValue.description: A value as K-02 v1 types a field's value: a string, an integer, a boolean, money or a time as the shared formats write them (K-02 v1 fieldValue; CQ-09).

valueName.title: EvalValueName
valueName.description: A value's name: a gives key, a record value or field, or a message slot of K-01 v1's slot list (K-01 v1 answerField.name; K-01 README 'The slot list'), such as booked, time_saved, svc.intext or price.

measureName.title: MeasureName
measureName.description: One of section 08's measures (arch 08 lines 427 to 445), its hard-invariants row aside, which the report gives on its own (hardInvariants): rightStepInChoices (right step is among the choices code builds, at least 99.5%); lowStakesDecisions (right decision on low-stakes turns, at least 97%); highStakesDecisions (right decision on high-stakes turns, at least 99.5%); harmfulWrongActions (at most 0.2% of turns); needlessQuestions (needless extra questions, at most 6.7% of turns); dangerFound (danger found, at least 99%); falseAlarms (at most 5%); wholeChats (whole chats right in 4 runs of 4, at least 90%); fallbackMessages (messages sent as fallback text or 'I've passed this on.', at most 1%, DD); misstatedMessages (messages that misstate the record, show a field past its audience or miss a needed value, at most 0.2%, DD). README 'How each measure is counted'.

effectClass.title: EffectClass
effectClass.description: The class of a committed effect a harmful wrong action is graded on: money, booking, consent, contact or safety (arch 08 line 447: 'a committed money, booking, consent, contact or safety effect, or a value in one, that the gold label does not contain').

changedEffectClass.title: ChangedEffectClass
changedEffectClass.description: The classes of effect a bundle's replay lists when they differ from the last passing bundle's: money, booking, consent or safety (BP 8 'Bundle': 'every money, booking, consent or safety effect that differs from the last passing bundle on the same replay'; arch 10 line 552; BP section 10's card: 'money 0, booking 0, consent 0, safety 0').

audienceKind.title: EvalAudience
audienceKind.description: Who may see a field: customer, staff, owner, securePageOnly or never (RULES 4.5; arch 06 line 311, limit 7; 02-contracts section 2 item 3).

safetyLabel.title: GoldSafetyLabel
safetyLabel.description: One gold safety label for a raw text: one of the 8 outcomes of A3-22 and B3-17 with its tense (02-contracts K-10 'for danger cases the outcome labels and tense'; K-02 v1 safetyOutcome and tense; arch 06 line 329). Never Unsure: a gold label knows the answer (Unsure is the safety read's own marker, K-02 v1).

outcome.description: The outcome, as A3-22's and B3-17's branch labels give it word for word (K-02 v1 safetyOutcome), never Unsure.

tense.description: Its tense: now, could restart, over, joke or unknown; over and joke are not danger (K-02 v1 tense; arch 06 line 329; arch 06 line 283: 'the gas leak was fixed in March' stays No).

goldText.title: GoldText
goldText.description: One inbound text of a turn, with its variant and its gold safety labels (02-contracts K-10 'the inbound text or texts, with their variant (a paraphrase, a typo, Spanish, several requests in one text: arch 08 line 449), send time and zone'). text is the text exactly as K-02 v1 gives it to decide: event id, kind (a text, a poll vote or a tapback), words after the edge scrub, send time and zone, attachments, poll, tapback (K-02 v1 text; arch 06 line 309: dates resolve from the send time).

variants.description: How the generator varied the walk's own words: paraphrase, typo, spanish, severalRequests (arch 08 line 449: 'paraphrases, typos, Spanish, several requests in one text'). Empty: the step graph's own words, as the master writes them.

safety.description: The text's gold safety labels, at least one: an ordinary text reads No with tense now, as K-02 v1's safety-no.json does (arch 06 line 283: every raw text is read; 02-contracts K-10). A danger case is a text with a label other than No whose tense is now, could restart or unknown (README 'How each measure is counted').

goldChoice.title: GoldChoice
goldChoice.description: The right choice of a part, by what it is, never by the turn's own choice id, which code makes per turn (K-02 v1 choice.choiceId; T-360 finding 3). Its kind and step, then the branch label word for word, the any-time row, the door or the hub, and the booking it acts on, each as K-02 v1's choice fills them (arch 01 line 67; arch 03 lines 159 to 167, 189). The harness matches the decide result's choice to this through the context it built.

kind.description: option, hub, anytime, door, searchEntry or whichBooking (K-02 v1 choiceKind; arch 01 line 67).

step.description: The step behind the choice: the open question's step, the hub step, the any-time row's handler in this flow, the door step, the entry step, or the booking's hub (K-02 v1 choice.step). With a branch, it is the turn's right step (02-contracts K-10 'the right step').

branch.description: The branch label word for word, for an option or a hub case; null otherwise (K-02 v1 choice.branch; SPEC-master 5d).

anytimeRow.description: For an any-time row, which of the 21; null otherwise (K-02 v1 choice.anytimeRow; arch 03 line 171).

door.description: For a door, which one; null otherwise (K-02 v1 choice.door; arch 03 line 165).

hub.description: For a hub case, the stage whose hub it is; null otherwise (K-02 v1 choice.hub; arch 03 line 163).

bookingId.description: The booking the choice acts on, from the seed state, or null when it is about no booking yet, such as a door to a new booking (arch 03 line 159: 'Questions about other bookings add only their options, labeled by business, date and time'; K-02 v1 target.bookingId). For whichBooking, the booking it stands for (arch 03 line 167).

kind.description: Each kind fills what it uses and leaves the rest null, as K-02 v1's choice does (arch 01 line 67; arch 03 lines 163 to 167, 189).

goldField.title: GoldField
goldField.description: One field the right choice's answer carries, with its type and its gold value (arch 08 line 447: 'Right decision: the chosen choices and every field value equal the gold label'; K-01 v1 answerField: the branch's fields, from the gives keys and record values). A field without its value is refused (refuse-item-without-field-values.json). A text field's value is the words as written, since code re-parses every value from its words (arch 03 line 185; arch 06 line 309, limit 6).

type.description: Its type: text, integer, boolean, money, time, zone, id or choice (K-01 v1 answerField.type).

value.description: The gold value, of the field's type: a string for text, zone, id or choice, an integer, a boolean, or money or a time as the shared formats write them (K-02 v1 fieldValue; CQ-09).

type.description: The value has the field's type (K-01 v1 answerField.type; CQ-09).

goldPart.title: GoldPart
goldPart.description: One part of the gold label: its verb, the right choice and every field value (02-contracts K-10 'per part the verb, choice and every field value'; arch 03 line 183: one verb per part of the text; K-02 v1 decidePart). choose takes an option, a hub case or a which-booking choice; enter takes a door, an any-time row or an entry step; every other verb takes no choice and no fields; hand_off says whom it is about.

verb.description: choose, enter, ask, none_fits, pass_on, hand_off, redact or no_op (arch 03 line 183; K-02 v1 decidePart).

choice.description: The right choice for choose and enter; null for the other verbs (arch 03 line 183).

fields.description: Every field the right choice's answer carries, each with its gold value; empty when it carries none, and for the verbs that take no choice (arch 08 line 447).

about.description: For hand_off, whom it is about: ownerOrStaff or other (K-02 v1 handOffAbout; arch 06 line 329); null for the other verbs.

verb.description: The verb fixes what the part carries (arch 03 line 183; K-02 v1 README 'Verbs and what code checks').

namedValue.title: NamedValue
namedValue.description: A name and its value (K-02 v1 fieldValue's types; CQ-09).

goldEffect.title: GoldEffect
goldEffect.description: One money, booking, consent, contact or safety effect the turn should commit, with the values in it, so a harmful wrong action can be graded: a committed effect of these classes, or a value in one, that the gold label does not contain (arch 08 line 447; 02-contracts K-10 'the effects it should commit'). Written in K-01 v1's effect words, as the walk gives them from each branch's effects (K-01 v1 effect: arch 01 line 77); a message or a clock is no such effect. K-07 v1's effect rows are how charges, refunds and calendar writes run.

class.description: money, booking, consent, contact or safety (arch 08 line 447).

kind.description: recordWrite (a gives key or record field written), charge, refund, calendarWrite or flag (K-01 v1 effect.kind, its message and clock kinds aside).

ref.description: What it acts on: the gives key or record field written, the record amount charged or refunded, the booking a calendar write is for, or the step whose effect sets a flag (K-01 v1 effect.ref).

flag.description: For kind flag only: deceased, stopped, private or paused (K-01 v1 effect.flag; arch 03 line 175).

values.description: The values the effect commits, such as the booked time and service, or the amount (arch 08 line 447: 'or a value in one').

kind.description: A flag names its flag; no other kind does (K-01 v1 effect.flag).

messageValue.title: GoldMessageValue
messageValue.description: A value an outgoing message must carry, and who may see that field (02-contracts K-10 'for each outgoing message the values it must carry and who may see each field'; RULES 4.5).

name.description: The slot or field the value fills, such as svc.intext or price (K-01 v1's slot list; K-01 README 'The slot list').

value.description: The value as the record holds it (K-02 v1 fieldValue's types; CQ-09).

audience.description: Who may see the field, at least one (RULES 4.5; arch 06 line 311, limit 7; 02-contracts section 2 item 3).

goldMessage.title: GoldMessage
goldMessage.description: One outgoing message the turn should cause, with the values it must carry, for the measure of messages that misstate the record, show a field past its audience or miss a needed value (arch 08 line 445; 02-contracts K-10).

step.description: The step whose message it is (K-01 v1 message; SPEC-master 4 'say').

to.description: Who gets it, as the bundle's message names the lane (K-01 v1 lane: owner, san, staff, cust, agent, pay, out, other).

values.description: The values it must carry; empty when it carries none, such as a fixed safety line (arch 08 line 445: 'miss a needed value').

goldLabel.title: GoldLabel
goldLabel.description: A turn's gold label: the text's language, its stakes, whether a question is expected, one entry per part (verb, right choice, every field value), the effects it should commit and the messages it should cause (02-contracts K-10 'the gold label'; arch 08 line 447). A turn the safety read alone decides, or a safety-only item, has no parts and null stakes: it is graded on its texts' safety labels, its effects and its messages (README 'The gold label').

language.description: The text's language as decide should report it, a two-letter code such as en or es (K-02 v1 language; CQ-07's default: the decide reads return it and must agree; arch 06 line 341).

stakes.description: high or low (arch 01 line 79; K-02 v1 stakes, derived by its README's 'Stakes' rule, CQ-20); null when the turn has no parts.

questionExpected.description: Whether the right reply asks the writer a question, for needless extra questions (arch 08 line 437; 02-contracts K-10 'whether a question is expected').

parts.description: One entry per part of the text, in the text's order (arch 03 line 183); empty for a turn the safety read alone decides.

effects.description: Every money, booking, consent, contact or safety effect the turn should commit; empty when it should commit none (arch 08 line 447).

messages.description: The outgoing messages the turn should cause whose values are graded (arch 08 line 445).

parts.description: A turn with parts has its stakes; a turn with none has null stakes (arch 01 line 79).

goldTurn.title: GoldTurn
goldTurn.description: One turn of an item: the steps walked to it, its inbound texts (one batch: arch 02 line 113) and its gold label (02-contracts K-10).

walk.description: The steps walked, in order, ending at the step whose question or check the turn's texts meet; for a turn that answers a question still open from the turn before, that step alone (02-contracts K-10 'the steps walked'; arch 08 line 449: 'so every item has a known right step').

texts.description: The turn's inbound texts, in send order (arch 02 line 113: a batch joins texts that come close together).

writer.title: GoldWriter
writer.description: Who writes the item's texts: the handle, the person, the role, the stored language and the channel (02-contracts K-10 'the writer's role, language and channel').

handle.description: The handle's id in K-04's handles table, never the raw number or address: an id that cannot read as a phone number, email address or words, as K-08 v1's handle reference is (K-08 v1 handleRef and safeId; arch 01 line 55).

personId.description: The person behind the handle, or null when none is known yet, such as a new mobile (K-02 v1 person.personId; FS line 743).

role.description: The writer's role at the item's business: owner, admin, staff, ownBusiness or customer (K-02 v1 person.roles; FS line 723), or none for a writer with no role there yet.

language.description: The writer's stored language, or null (K-02 v1 person.language; arch 06 line 341).

channel.description: Where the texts come from: imessage, rcs or sms through Linq, or email (K-07 v1 port: Linq's imessage, rcs and sms channels and the email channel; DL-012: no SMS provider); page (free text from a secure page) or agent (free text from an outside AI) (K-02 v1 safetyResult.source; arch 02 line 129).

seedOpenQuestion.title: SeedOpenQuestion
seedOpenQuestion.description: An open question sent to the writer's handle before the turn (02-contracts K-10 'with the open questions ... before the turn'; arch 01 line 63; K-04's open question row). If the named database seeds lack it, the harness writes it from this before the turn.

id.description: The open question's row id (arch 01 line 63).

step.description: The step that asked it (arch 01 line 63).

status.description: waiting (not delivered yet) or open (arch 09 line 490; arch 02 line 127: its clock arms at the first delivery receipt).

askCount.description: How many times it has been asked (arch 01 line 63).

bookingId.description: The booking it is about, or null (arch 03 line 159).

seedBooking.title: SeedBooking
seedBooking.description: The booking the turn is about, with its stage before the turn (02-contracts K-10 'booking stage ... before the turn'; arch 03 line 163: hubs follow the booking's stage; K-04 bookings.stage: entry, booked, checked_in, done, cancelled).

stage.description: Its stage before the turn (K-04 v1 bookings_stage_known).

flags.title: SeedFlags
flags.description: The record flags in force for the writer and the booking before the turn: deceased, stopped, private, paused (02-contracts K-10 'record flags before the turn'; K-01 v1 effect.flag; arch 03 line 175).

fixtureSeed.title: FixtureSeed
fixtureSeed.description: The seed state a walked item runs on: a fixture set v1 demo shop and the database seed fixtures loaded, with the open questions, booking stage and record flags before the first turn (02-contracts K-10 'the seed state it runs on (a fixture set v1 shop and its database seeds)').

shop.description: The fixture set v1 demo shop, by its file's base name in fixtures/v1/test-kit/shops/, such as barber (MC 5; Q-36: fixture set v1 is checksummed).

business.description: The seeded business the turn is about, by its row id (K-04 businesses), or null when there is none yet.

rows.description: The database seed fixtures loaded, as paths inside contracts/, such as db-schema/core/fixtures/seed-person-roles.json, each loaded after the ones its own 'after' names (02-contracts section 2 item 3; the database parts' seed rows).

openQuestions.description: The open questions sent to the writer's handle before the first turn (arch 03 line 159).

booking.description: The booking the item is about, with its stage, or null for none (arch 03 line 163).

liveTurnSeed.title: LiveTurnSeed
liveTurnSeed.description: The seed state of a human-labelled live turn: the live turn it replays, with the open questions, booking stage and record flags it found (arch 08 line 449: 300 human-labelled live turns a month; arch 10 line 552: replay of live turns). After launch only; such an item holds a real person's words, so it never enters the repository, a fixture or a test (BP rule 9).

kind.description: liveTurn: a human-labelled live turn's seed.

business.description: The business the turn was about (K-04 businesses).

openQuestions.description: The open questions the turn found (arch 03 line 159).

booking.description: The booking it was about, with its stage, or null.

overlayRef.title: OverlayRef
overlayRef.description: An approved overlay the item was labelled with, as the bundle's manifest lists it (K-01 v1 inputFile of kind approvedOverlay: path, sha256 and approval version; arch 12 line 592: 'fixes go in an overlay Jay approves'; Q-17; J-18).

path.description: Its path, as the manifest's input gives it (K-01 v1 inputFile.path).

sha256.description: The sha256 of its bytes (K-01 v1 sha256; Q-36).

version.description: Its approval version or date as written (K-01 v1 inputFile.version).

goldItem.title: GoldItem
goldItem.description: One gold-set item: one turn, or a whole chat as a sequence of turns, walked from the step graph with its gold label (02-contracts K-10 'A gold-set item'; arch 08 lines 447 to 449; BP starting shape, last paragraph). Written once and never rewritten (QUESTIONS.md M2-qa-frontend.2: each paraphrase stored, never rewritten). path is the flow, money path, booking values, switches and facts the walk ran, with the trade's full set of switches and facts (K-01 v1 path; Q-35: parity with each trade's full switches and facts).

setVersion.description: The gold-set version that added it (02-contracts K-10 'its id and set version').

kind.description: turn: one turn; wholeChat: a whole chat, a sequence of turns of one handle's chat replayed in order, right only when every turn is right in every run (arch 08 line 441: 'Whole chats right in 4 runs of 4').

journey.description: The journey the item belongs to, as K-01 v1's journey membership places its step (K-01 v1 journeyGate.steps; BP starting shape: the gold set is made journey by journey).

trade.description: The trade whose overlay the walk runs (K-01 v1 tradeId; 02-contracts K-10 'trade').

seed.description: The seed state it runs on (02-contracts K-10): a fixture set v1 shop and its database seeds for a walked item, the live turn for a human-labelled one.

labelledFrom.description: The bundle and the approved overlays it was labelled from: a journey's gold set is labelled only from its approved overlays (BP starting shape, last paragraph; J-18; Q-17).

overlays.description: The approved overlays applied, by their manifest input; empty when none applies.

labelledBy.description: walk: generated by walking the step graph, so the label is the walk's; human: one of the human-labelled live turns after launch (arch 08 line 449).

turns.description: The turns in order: exactly one for kind turn, two or more for a whole chat (arch 08 line 441).

kind.description: A turn item holds one turn, a whole chat two or more (arch 08 line 441).

labelledBy.description: A walked item runs on a fixture set v1 seed; a human-labelled one on its live turn (arch 08 line 449; BP rule 9).

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: A 95% interval as proportions from 0 to 1, unrounded (BP 8 'Eval gate': 'each reported as right out of total with its 95% interval'; CQ-10's default method; README 'The interval'). A release card shows it in percent to one decimal (BP section 10: 94.6–99.4%).

measureResult.title: MeasureResult
measureResult.description: One section 08 measure in a report: its target and direction, the count out of the total, the point estimate, its 95% interval, the sized volume and the status (02-contracts K-10 'per section 08 measure'; BP 8 'Eval gate'). The arithmetic is the named rule reportNumbers.

direction.description: atLeast for a measure whose point estimate must reach its target, atMost for one that must stay at or under it (02-contracts K-10 'its target and direction (at least or at most)'; arch 08's table).

target.description: The target as a proportion, such as 0.97 for 97% (arch 08 lines 427 to 445; README 'How each measure is counted' lists section 08's).

count.description: What the measure counts: the right ones for an atLeast measure, the failures (harmful actions, needless questions, false alarms, fallbacks, misstated messages) for an atMost one (BP 8: 'right out of total'; README 'How each measure is counted').

total.description: Out of how many units of the slice: turns, texts, chats or messages, as the measure counts them (README 'How each measure is counted').

point.description: The point estimate, count divided by total, unrounded; null when total is 0 (BP 8 'Eval gate').

interval.description: Its 95% interval; null when total is 0 (BP 8; CQ-10).

sizedVolume.description: The total at which the bar is proven, as J-19 sizes it; null until J-19 sizes it (Q-16's default). Below it, or with none, the status is never met (BP 8: 'Below a bar's sized volume (J-19), write the interval and "not yet proven", never "met"').

status.description: met: at or past its sized volume, with the bound facing the target clearing it (the lower bound for atLeast, the upper for atMost: BP 8, the plan's sizing rule); notYetProven: the point estimate meets the target but the bar is not proven, below its volume or unsized (BP 8; Q-16; J-19), or nothing was counted; miss: the point estimate misses the target, a target miss at any volume (BP 8: 'A point estimate below its target is a target miss (rule 7.10)').

total.description: With nothing counted there is no estimate and nothing is proven; otherwise the estimate and its interval are given (BP 8).

status.description: A bar with no sized volume is never met (BP 8; Q-16; J-19).

measures.title: Measures
measures.description: Every section 08 measure, each by its name, with its direction fixed by the measure (arch 08's table; 02-contracts K-10 'per section 08 measure'). A measure the slice has nothing for has total 0.

invariantResult.title: InvariantResult
invariantResult.description: One hard invariant on the run: its breaches and the items that breached it (arch 08 line 427: target 100%; BP 8: 'zero hard-invariant breaches').

breaches.description: How many breaches the run found; any one fails the gate (02-contracts K-10).

items.description: The items that breached it, each once.

regression.title: Regression
regression.description: An item the last passing bundle got right that this one gets wrong, with its explanation (BP 8 'Eval gate': 'a list on the card of every item the last passing bundle got right that this one gets wrong, each explained').

turn.description: The turn, counting from 1 (1 for an item of kind turn).

measure.description: The measure it went wrong on (arch 08's table).

explanation.description: Why it is now wrong, in plain words (BP 8: 'each explained').

changedEffect.title: ChangedEffect
changedEffect.description: One money, booking, consent or safety effect that differs from the last passing bundle's on the same replay: what that bundle committed and what this one commits (BP 8 'Bundle'; arch 10 line 552: 'Rosie's team reviews each changed money, booking, consent or safety effect').

replayed.description: What was replayed: a gold item, a fixture set v1 scenario (before launch: 'the gold set and the fixture set v1 scenarios', BP 8 'Bundle'), or a live turn (from launch: the last 7 days, arch 10 line 552).

id.description: The gold item's id, the scenario's id in fixture set v1's test-kit, or the live turn's id (CQ-09).

turn.description: The turn of a gold item, counting from 1; null for a scenario or a live turn.

last.description: The effects of this class the last passing bundle committed there (none: empty).

now.description: The effects of this class this bundle commits there (none: empty).

accuracyReport.title: AccuracyReport
accuracyReport.description: What one eval run of a bundle found on the gold set or its smoke slice (02-contracts K-10 'An accuracy report'; arch 08; arch 10 line 552; BP 8 'Bundle', 'Eval gate', 'Journey milestone'; BP section 10's release card, whose accuracy lines read from it). Before launch the replay is the gold set and fixture set v1's scenarios (BP 8 'Bundle').

bundleId.description: The bundle run (arch 10 line 548: the bundle id on every turn and trace).

slice.description: smoke: the fixed smoke slice a branch that changes what the AI does runs before its merge; full: the whole gold set, nightly and for each bundle candidate (BP 5.2; Q-20: the smoke slice only until the model budget is set).

ranAt.description: When the run ended, in UTC (02-contracts K-10 'date'; CQ-09).

runs.description: How many times each item ran (arch 08 line 441: whole chats are judged in 4 runs of 4).

models.description: The model ids the run used (K-01 v1 manifest.models; arch 11 line 564).

modelCalls.description: live: the models were called; recordedDouble: the recorded-model double answered, so the numbers check the code around the models, not the models (Q-20's default; K-02 v1 consumers: C-123).

journeys.description: The journeys whose items the slice holds, each once (BP 8 'Journey milestone').

items.description: How many gold items the slice held.

interval.description: How every interval in the report is computed: the two-sided 95% Wilson score interval (CQ-10's default; one-sided or two-sided bounds stay J-19's, Q-16).

measures.description: Every section 08 measure over the whole slice (02-contracts K-10).

byJourney.description: The same measures on each journey's items, one entry per journey the slice holds (BP 8 'Journey milestone': 'each measure's point estimate at or above its target on that journey's items').

hardInvariants.description: Each hard invariant's breaches on the run; any one fails the gate (arch 08 line 427; BP 8; K-08 v1 invariantCheck names).

cost.description: Cost per completed booking on the gold set, at most $0.16 (arch 10 line 552: '$49 over 300 bookings a month'; BP 8 'Bundle'; CQ-12's definition: a gold chat whose label ends in a committed booking; the cost of every model call in the slice's turns, divided by the number of such chats). In micro-dollars, as K-08 v1 costs model calls.

completedBookings.description: The gold items whose label ends in a committed booking (A6-10's booked) (CQ-12).

costMicroUsd.description: The cost of every model call in the slice's turns, in millionths of a US dollar (CQ-12; K-08 v1 modelCall.cost_micro_usd).

perBookingMicroUsd.description: costMicroUsd divided by completedBookings, unrounded; null with no completed booking (CQ-12).

status.description: met: at or under the target; miss: over it; notMeasured: no completed booking in the slice, so the gate is not shown met (BP 8 'Bundle').

completedBookings.description: With no completed booking there is no cost per booking (CQ-12).

replyTime.description: Reply p50 and p95 over the run's turns, from the traces (K-08 v1 replyTime: from the last text's arrival to Linq accepting the first part; arch 04 line 229: p50 at most 10 s, p95 at most 18 s; arch 10 line 552); null when the run measured none.

turns.description: How many turns' reply times were read.

p50Ms.description: The median reply time, in milliseconds (nearest rank; README default 15).

p95Ms.description: The 95th percentile reply time, in milliseconds (nearest rank; README default 15).

lastPassingBundleId.description: The last bundle whose gate passed, the one regressions and changed effects compare with; null for the first gate, which then lists none (BP 8 'Bundle', 'Eval gate'; arch 08 line 447: a breach rolls back to the last passing bundle).

regressions.description: Every item the last passing bundle got right that this one gets wrong, each explained; empty when there is none (BP 8 'Eval gate').

changedEffects.description: Every money, booking, consent or safety effect that differs from the last passing bundle on the same replay, with the count of each class (BP 8 'Bundle'; arch 10 line 552; BP section 10's card: 'Changed effects: none (money 0, booking 0, consent 0, safety 0)').

counts.description: How many changed effects of each class are listed (BP section 10's card).

lastPassingBundleId.description: The first gate has no bundle to compare with, so it lists no regression and no changed effect (BP 8).
